reasons.correctness: Every interface name matches. PLN always returns 1, case-insensitive matching works, rounding is HALF_UP to 2 decimals, and BusinessRuleTranslatableException carries the key and the ISO code. Build green, acceptance 5/5, existing 41/41.
reasons.convention_fit: ExchangeRatePort sits in currency/port and FixedExchangeRateAdapter in currency/adapter. The service depends only on the port. Injection is by constructor. The new key is in both messages_en and messages_pl. Nothing sits in a technical top-level package.
reasons.design_fit: Clean port/adapter split with a small footprint. Minor smell: the adapter uppercases the code, then equalsIgnoreCase-scans every map entry instead of a direct lookup. The properties class uses @Configuration rather than the project's @EnableConfigurationProperties pattern.
reasons.test_quality: CurrencyConversionServiceUnitTest covers conversion, the HALF_UP boundary and the missing-rate exception key and args. The adapter test covers case, PLN, configured and missing codes, but lacks @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class). No null-ISO case is tested.
reasons.graph_use: Two graph queries found the currency entities and the existing Port/Adapter/Properties/TranslatableException examples. The edits followed the CompanyRegistryPort/BialaListaVatAdapter reads. Later navigation relied on grep and glob.
